title: Quantum provides £30m for 232-bed Durham student scheme
summary:
Quantum Development Finance has provided £30 million in debt funding to Asset Capital for the development of Melbury Court, a 232-bed purpose-built student accommodation scheme in Durham. The project carries a gross development value of £46 million and is scheduled for completion in summer 2027.

title: Stirling veterinary hospital secures £1.57m finance
summary:
Shawbrook has provided £1.57m in development finance to WS Dunsire & Sons for the conversion of a former hotel and restaurant into a veterinary hospital in Stirling. The 14-month facility funded the transformation of the former Hollybank restaurant in St Ninians into a specialist animal care facility with a gross development value of approximately £2.86m.

title: Prime London market stalls as buyers hesitate and sellers resist price cuts
summary:
Prime London's property market is experiencing a slowdown driven by hesitant buyers and sellers maintaining unrealistic price expectations, according to a buying agent operating in the capital. Viewing activity remains high but transactions are stalling as buyers delay decisions amid economic uncertainty.

title: High-value mortgages grow outside London and South East
summary:
The number of homebuyers taking out mortgages exceeding £500,000 has increased significantly outside London and the South East, according to data from Savills. In the year to October, 3,875 buyers in the North purchased properties with mortgages worth more than £500,000, representing a 16% increase compared to five years ago.

title: Capital Gains Tax rates unchanged for landlords in Budget
summary:
Landlords will not face an increase in Capital Gains Tax liabilities following confirmation that Chancellor John Healey will not raise rates in next week's Budget. Analysis shows that aligning CGT with income tax rates could have resulted in additional liabilities of up to £15,633 for additional-rate taxpayers on a typical decade-long property gain.

title: 41% of English homes on market have reduced asking prices
summary:
Analysis of Zoopla listings reveals that 165,647 of the 403,962 properties on the market in England have undergone price reductions. The South East recorded the highest proportion at 43.9%, whilst the West Midlands saw the sharpest rise in reduced stock since August, up 7.7%.

title: Scottish markets lead UK for fastest property sales
summary:
Properties in Motherwell, Scotland are five times more likely to find a buyer within three months compared to homes in north west London, according to new data from Zoopla. The portal's analysis reveals significant regional disparities in selling times across the UK.

title: Google Cloud outage disrupts Rightmove and major banks
summary:
Rightmove and several major UK banks experienced service disruptions following a power failure at Google's Europe-West2 data centre in London. The outage affected logged-in services at the property portal and banking operations at Lloyds, Halifax, RBS, HSBC and Revolut.

title: OSB Group completes £25.9m Manchester refinance in 21 days
summary:
OSB Group has completed a £25.9 million mixed-use refinance for a property developer in Manchester, funding a scheme comprising 93 apartments and basement commercial space at Barclay House. The lender moved from formal offer to completion in 21 days, with funding arriving just over a month after the initial referral.

title: Edinburgh Georgian townhouse conversion yields double-digit return
summary:
Develop North PLC has completed a £1.25 million hotel financing transaction in Edinburgh, converting a Georgian townhouse into a 16-bedroom hotel that has since been refinanced through a long-term commercial mortgage. The real estate investment company provided the funding to AM Number Three Ltd in March 2025, secured against 3 John's Place in Leith.
